d1_rating.l: How has the trade order enforcement affected traffic flow, vehicular congestion, and pedestrian walkway accessibility in high-density commercial hubs?

d6_rating.l: How has compliance with physical planning standards and the reduction of unauthorized structures on road reserves evolved?

affil.technical_officer: Technical Officer (Chief Administrative Officer / Town Clerk, Commercial Officer, Physical Planner / Urban Planning Department)
affil.law_enforcement: Law Enforcement Officer (Municipal Police Unit, Public Health Officer, Environment & Sanitation Department)
affil.commercial_led: Commercial Office / Local Economic Development (LED) Unit
affil.trader_rep: Business Community / Trader Representative (Market Vendors Association, Hawkers/Street Vendors, Formal SME representatives)
affil.other_informant: Other Key Informant (e.g., MoLG official, UAAU representative, Religious/Civil Society leader)

positive.congestion: Reduced traffic congestion and improved pedestrian walkway mobility
positive.sanitation: Cleaner drainage systems and improved general urban sanitation/waste management
positive.stalls: Increased uptake of stalls in gazetted markets
positive.osr: Growth in Local Government Own Source Revenue (OSR) projections/collections

challenges.sme_resistance: Resistance and pushback from small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) / informal vendors
challenges.funding: Inadequate funding and logistical capacity for enforcement teams
challenges.force: Allegations of excessive use of force or human rights concerns

enf_status.continuous: Continuous, routine daily monitoring and enforcement
enf_status.suspended: Suspended or relaxed enforcement following stakeholder pushback
enf_status.reactive: Strictly reactive enforcement (only in response to central government directives)

livelihood.severe: Severely negative impact on daily income

alt_provided.partial: Partially provided, but too costly or distant

alt_suit.suitable: Highly accessible, affordable, and adequately sized for business operations
alt_suit.poor: Poorly located (out of customer reach), inadequate infrastructure, or too costly (high stall rent/taxes)
alt_suit.none: No alternative spaces were provided prior to displacement
